video_candidate_worklist.rule: Review the non-news roster first, then broaden exact program discovery. Aim for twelve substantive candidates across six publisher families, eight non-news. Prefer two qualified non-news selections. A genuine unavailable or inadequate pool requires exact evidence, not invented candidates or weaker playback. Every registered route still receives its own attempt.

scientific_papers.selection_rule: Seek one genuinely qualifying original-paper-led story within every rolling 3 editions. Record real methods, sample, limitations, venue and original paper link. Distinguish preprint from peer review. Never force an unqualified or stale paper, change 2/2/2, or bypass freshness/novelty/protected gates.
scientific_papers.evidence_caveat: Verified means reported in explicit edition receipts; neither source discovery nor this planner proves a published paper or independent peer-review status.

prelock_research_targets.source_census_timing: Before selection when actually executable; a later census never counts as preselection research

video_discovery_fallbacks.evidence: Microsoft Learn provides publisher-owned episode pages and chapters. This example documents discovery and carries no current-edition or playback qualification.

rule: Plan enabled editorial sources as before; prioritize qualified original scientific-paper leads when the seven-edition paper target is due or historical evidence is missing, without forcing publication.
